# isInt64Array

> Test if a value is an [Int64Array][@stdlib/array/int64].

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var isInt64Array = require( '@stdlib/assert/is-int64array' );
```

#### isInt64Array( value )

Tests if a value is an [`Int64Array`][@stdlib/array/int64].

```javascript
var Int64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int64' );

var bool = isInt64Array( new Int64Array( 10 ) );
// returns true

bool = isInt64Array( [] );
// returns false
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var Int8Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int8' );
var Uint8Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint8' );
var Uint8ClampedArray = require( '@stdlib/array/uint8c' );
var Int16Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int16' );
var Uint16Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint16' );
var Int32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int32' );
var Uint32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint32' );
var Float32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/float32' );
var Float64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/float64' );
var Complex64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/complex64' );
var Int64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int64' );
var isInt64Array = require( '@stdlib/assert/is-int64array' );

var bool = isInt64Array( new Int64Array( 10 ) );
// returns true

bool = isInt64Array( new Complex64Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Float64Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Int8Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Uint8Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Uint8ClampedArray( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Int16Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Uint16Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Int32Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Uint32Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( new Float32Array( 10 ) );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( [] );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( {} );
// returns false

bool = isInt64Array( null );
// returns false
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
